subject: Request: onboarding for pilot — invoice-only path / PO waiver evaluation
messages:
From: Sara Linde <sara@fjordedge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot onboarding — can you confirm invoice-only option and evidence needed?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking our demo last week. We’re excited to kick off a 6-week pilot with Redwood — technical team is ready. Procurement here is small and we don’t operate with POs for pilots. Before I open a purchasing request, can you confirm: 

- Whether FjordEdge can be onboarded on an invoice-only (no-PO) path temporarily;
- What documents / evidence Redwood requires to approve that exception and any limits (time/amount); and
- Any internal approval ladder we should be aware of so we can prepare our AP side.

I can provide a company registration, W-9 equivalent, and sample invoice. Estimated spend for the pilot is ~€4k/month.

Appreciate a quick note so we can align with our finance team.

Best,
Sara
Sara Linde
Head of Operations, FjordEdge
accounts-payable@fjordedge.com
[Attachment: none yet]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Linde <sara@fjordedge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — can you confirm invoice-only option and evidence needed?

Hi Sara — great to hear, and glad the demo went well. Short answer: we can evaluate a temporary invoice-only path for pilot engagements, but there are a small set of documents and constraints required by Finance/Procurement to approve the exception.

What we need from FjordEdge to start the review:

- Legal entity name + company registration (signed/official PDF)
- Tax form / W‑9 equivalent (or EU VAT registration)
- Sample invoice template your AP will send (PDF)
- Estimated monthly spend and pilot timeline (you mentioned ~€4k/mo; confirm start/end dates)
- Point of contact in your AP (name + email)

Constraints that typically apply for invoice-only exceptions:

- Temporary duration (default 90 days); extension requires re-review
- Monthly cap (Finance may set a spend cap; initial approval often ≤ €10k/month)
- Evidence sampling and occasional audit requests

Laura (Procurement), Markus (Finance) — can you confirm that framing and whether we should add any contract addendum / SLA clause for pilot data handling?

I’ll follow up with a draft onboarding checklist once you send the docs.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwood.com]

From: Sara Linde <sara@fjordedge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@fjordedge.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:21:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — can you confirm invoice-only option and evidence needed?

Hi Jonas — thanks, attached are the documents you requested.

Attachments:
- FjordEdge_Company-Registration.pdf (official company registration)
- FjordEdge_W9.pdf (EU VAT + tax summary)
- FjordEdge_InitialInvoiceSample.pdf (sample invoice PDF)

Pilot timeline: 2027-04-20 to 2027-06-30 (6 weeks + buffer). Point of contact for AP is me (accounts-payable@fjordedge.com) and our controller, Michael Berg (michael.berg@fjordedge.com).

One operational question: if Finance approves invoice-only for the pilot, would Redwood allow an internal payment threshold (e.g., invoices ≤ €5k processed without PO) and route larger invoices to PO flow? We’d like to keep things lean.

Also, do you need a signed order form / Addendum before we start, or can the invoice-only approval be processed in parallel with a short MSA addendum?

Thanks — Sara

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Linde <sara@fjordedge.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — can you confirm invoice-only option and evidence needed?

Hi Sara — thanks for the uploads, they look complete at first pass. From Procurement’s side we can provisionally approve a 90-day invoice-only onboarding for FjordEdge with these constraints: 

- Authorization: temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilot (90 days, expires 2027-07-12)
- Spend cap: invoices up to €5,000/month will process without PO; any single invoice > €5,000 will trigger PO workflow or escalation to Finance.
- Evidence: retain copies of invoices + account activity; Redwood may request transaction sampling up to 10% of invoices during the pilot.
- Security/compliance: Rely on the signed MSA addendum specifying data handling — please return signed addendum before pilot start or we will hold activation.

Markus / Naomi — would Finance like me to route this to procurement board for formal sign-off or approve under delegated authority? Naomi, given the spend cap, do you want to grant delegated approval for this pilot?

Sara — I’ve attached a short onboarding checklist and our MSA addendum template that you can sign. If you sign and return today, we’ll aim to open the account and have billing configured for the 20th.

Attachments:
- Redwood_InvoiceOnly_Onboarding_Checklist.docx (Checklist stub)
- Redwood_MSA_Addendum_Pilot.pdf (Addendum template)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
[laura_bennett@redwood.com]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Linde <sara@fjordedge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — can you confirm invoice-only option and evidence needed?

Thanks all — Naomi has granted delegated approval for the €5k/month temporary invoice-only path (internal note: Finance approval memo attached to deal). Sara, once you return the signed addendum Laura attached we’ll: 

1) Create the vendor record and allow invoice ingestion up to €5k/month;
2) Set the onboarding expiration for 2027-07-12 (system reminder will trigger 30 days prior);
3) Send a DocuSign link for the MSA addendum and a HubSpot deal update (DEAL-2027-047).

Next steps for FjordEdge:
- Sign and return Redwood_MSA_Addendum_Pilot.pdf via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/EXAMPLE/df7a2b)
- A/P sends first invoice to invoices@redwood.com referencing DEAL-2027-047

I’ll keep the ticket open and notify you when the vendor record is active. Looking forward to getting the pilot running.

—Jonas
